opinion.line: In every American community, you have varying shades of political opinion
stanza: In every American community, you have varying shades of political opinion
One of the shadiest of these is the liberals
An outspoken group on many subjects
Ten degrees to the left of center in good times
Ten degrees to the right of center if it affects them personally
So here, then, is a lesson in safe logic.
